title: Manufacturer
description: Definition of Manufacturer under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019

content.legal_definition: a person who— (i) makes any goods or parts thereof; or (ii) assembles any goods or parts thereof made by others; or (iii) puts or causes to be put his own mark on any goods made by any other person
content.plain_language: A person or company that makes, assembles, or labels a product as their own
examples: A business that assembles furniture from parts made by other companies
non_examples: A retailer that only sells products made by others without modifying them
A person who buys a product and resells it without changing it

user_queries: Who is considered a manufacturer under the law?
What does it mean to be a manufacturer?
